missing_implementations.title: Runtime capability enforcement — post-activation capability escalation not prevented
missing_implementations.expected: Fine-grained capability model: plugins can only use declared capabilities; runtime enforcement prevents post-activation capability escalation
missing_implementations.observed: PluginCapabilityNegotiator in plugin_interface.h is implemented; capability negotiation works at load time (plugin_manager.cpp:1288); but no runtime gate on the hot call path prevents plugins from using undeclared capabilities after activation
missing_implementations.resolution: PluginManager::checkCapabilityEscalation() added to plugin_manager.h/cpp. frozen_capabilities captured at load time in loadPlugin() and loadPluginFromPath(). Escalation detection compares current getCapabilities() against frozen snapshot; any new true flag triggers ERR_PLUGIN_CAPABILITY_ESCALATION (6311) and marks plugin as RESTRICTED via is_restricted flag. PluginManager::isPluginRestricted() queries restriction state. 14 tests in tests/test_plugin_capability_escalation.cpp (CapabilityEscalationBlockedTests/CapabilityEscalationLogicTests/CapabilityEscalationApiTests).

evidence.implementation_note: checkCapabilityEscalation() in plugin_manager.cpp; frozen_capabilities captured after initialize() call; ERR_PLUGIN_CAPABILITY_ESCALATION=6311 in error_registry.h

missing_implementations.suggested_issue_title: [plugins] Implement runtime capability enforcement to prevent post-activation capability escalation
